title: Bozorg, Krupinski & Jönsson (2014) PLoS Comput. Biol., Sampathkumar et al. (2014) eLife, Hamant et al. (2008) Science & Uyttewaal et al. (2012) Cell — Shoot Apical Meristem Shell Stress Anisotropy, Stress-vs-Strain Cytoskeletal Cue Discrimination, and Katanin-Mediated Organ Boundary Morphogenesis
organism: Arabidopsis thaliana (shoot apical meristem L1 epidermal shell, organ-meristem saddle boundary, cylindrical stem, and epidermal cells)

primary_sources.citation: Bozorg, Krupinski & Jönsson (2014) PLoS Computational Biology 10(1):e1003410
primary_sources.role: Finite-element pressurized shell and anisotropic viscoplastic growth model comparing maximal principal tensile stress (sigma_1) vs maximal principal strain (epsilon_1) as directional cues for cortical microtubule (CMT) and cellulose microfibril alignment across the SAM central dome (K > 0), organ-meristem saddle boundary (K = kappa_1 * kappa_2 < 0), cylindrical stem (sigma_theta / sigma_z = 2), laser cell ablation rings, and lateral compression perturbations

Subcellular and supracellular finite-element stress modeling, atomic force microscopy, and laser ablation proving that cortical microtubules align parallel to maximal principal tensile stress across curved cell walls and tissue boundaries

primary_sources.citation: Hamant, Heisler, Jönsson, Krupinski, Uyttewaal, Boudaoud, Meyerowitz & Traas (2008) Science 322(5908):1650-1655
primary_sources.role: Pressurized thin-shell principal stress model of the Arabidopsis shoot apical meristem demonstrating isotropic CMT organization on the spherical central dome, highly anisotropic circumferential alignment along the negative-Gaussian-curvature organ boundary crease, transverse CMT hoops on the cylindrical stem, circumferential reorientation around single-cell ablations, and boundary flattening under oryzalin microtubule depolymerization

Demonstrates that Katanin (BOTERO1 / KTN1) microtubule-severing activity controls the mechanical feedback gain gamma_MT coupling stress anisotropy to CMT ordering, and that bot1/ktn1 loss-of-function reduces CMT anisotropy and blunts organ-meristem boundary crease folding

meristem_zone_benchmarks.label: Organ-Meristem Saddle Boundary Crease (K = kappa_1 * kappa_2 < 0)

perturbation_and_genotype_benchmarks.label: Wild-Type Col-0 (Principal Stress Cue sigma_1 + Katanin WT)
